clauses.clause: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
clauses.evidence: [cast] and its two alternatives: 'ask target: [you_bear, you_giant, card]' (your creatures only, itself included; no opponent creature offered); the chosen one gets 1 PLUS_1_PLUS_1 (you_bear 2/2 -> 3/3, you_giant 4/4 -> 5/5, card 3/2); the counter stays after the turn ends. Also fires when put onto the battlefield on the opponent's turn. Cost G-1 W-2 = {2}{G}. Tree equal to parse template B2a-basris-lieutenant.

clauses.clause: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has trample.
clauses.evidence: Each cast variant: the countered creature gets keywords +TRAMPLE (including Pridemalkin itself); uncountered ones do not. Tree equal to parse template B5a-trample-counter. Pack pridemalkin_trample_only_your_countered (Tempered Veteran counters on your Ox and the opponent's Bear: Ox has trample, your uncountered Bear and the opponent's countered Bear do not) PASSES on the live tree and on this packet's tree.
